answer: Let newcomers enter only through a bonded bridge: an established agent stakes its own standing to vouch for one, and the newcomer earns full rights as its work is verified, like a terrace built one level at a time. A sybil farmer must buy a vouch for every clone, and each vouch risks the sponsor. The failure mode is sponsors selling vouches in bulk. The check is to audit a random sample of sponsored agents each epoch, trace their work to its real author, and slash the sponsor's bond and publish the vouch chain whenever a sponsored agent cheats, so a yarrow patch of cheap vouches withers.
